queries.query: Neiva Colombia official cadastral parcel map catastro IGAC geoportal
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Alcaldía de Neiva cadastral pages, the municipal Geoportal/Servicios Catastrales links, and IGAC Colombia en Mapas and ArcGIS REST cadastral services. The municipality is documented as a cadastral manager; a safe anonymous parcel geometry response for the WUP point was not verified.

queries.query: Neiva Colombia mapa catastral predios oficial catastro geoportal IGAC Alcaldía
queries.result: La búsqueda de primera parte encontró la Dirección de Gestión Catastral de la Alcaldía de Neiva, su página de Catastro Multipropósito y el servicio REST público de IGAC. La respuesta de consulta de predios por el punto WUP no quedó verificada de forma anónima; no se interpretó el tiempo de espera como ausencia catastral.

registryCustodian: Alcaldía Municipal de Neiva, Dirección de Gestión Catastral, documented as a municipal gestor catastral; IGAC is the national cadastral authority and publishes the public reference service.

registryEvidence.evidence: The municipal page lists duties to form, update, conserve and maintain cadastral information for Neiva; the 2021 municipal decree states IGAC habilitated Neiva as gestor catastral. IGAC REST metadata describes the national cadastral service and its parcel layers.

sourceReview.service: IGAC Dato Fundamental Catastro ArcGIS MapServer, with Alcaldía de Neiva municipal cadastral custodian
sourceReview.nativeFieldMapping: Parcel layer U_TERRENO exposes FID (ArcGIS OID) and CODIGO (30-character native cadastral code), alongside non-retained source fields. R_TERRENO exposes the same identity pattern for rural terrain.
sourceReview.compositeKeyProvenance: No composite key was used. CODIGO was observed in the official layer schema as the candidate native parcel identity; no parcel feature was retained.
sourceReview.crs: Service metadata declares EPSG:9377 (MAGNA-SIRGAS / Colombia Bogotá zone family); the service advertises output transformation and GeoJSON, but no geometry response was retained to independently validate coordinates.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier (CODIGO, only if feature-level stability is independently confirmed)
